name: frontend-design-qa
responsibility: Package reusable local frontend implementation guidance for the Frontend Design QA role in the co-installed WESEO WordPress/WST workflow: local Playwright MCP setup, Playwright MCP-driven browser QA, CSS/SCSS, Figma-to-code, Chrome Local Overrides spikes, responsive QA, optional project-local Playwright regression acceptance, and handoff QA writeback.
assumptions: The plugin is used from a local Cursor workspace on the developer's own machine that contains or mirrors the project frontend source files.
Playwright MCP is configured in the local Cursor workspace through this plugin's setup-playwright-mcp Skill and never inside a Remote-SSH workspace.
For the full WESEO WordPress/WST delivery workflow, this plugin is expected to be co-installed with wordpress-server-ops and wst-builder.
A filled Section handoff or CPT foundation handoff exists before local CSS, responsive QA, and browser QA work begin.

Project-specific theme tokens, URLs, Figma style mappings, repository details, deployment steps, WP Grid Builder IDs, and optional project-local Playwright test commands live in the project-local PROJECT-CONTEXT.md, the Section handoff, or the CPT foundation handoff.

rules.name: css-guideline
rules.description: Define reusable CSS and SCSS conventions for rem scaling, file structure, selectors, variables, responsive strategy, and formatting.

rules.name: css-theme-styles
rules.description: Preserve reusable WST and Astra styling patterns while leaving brand values and variants in project context.

rules.name: figma-to-code
rules.description: Guide Figma-to-code translation for grid sizing, spacing, typography, image behavior, and specificity checks.

rules.name: plugin-package-boundary
rules.description: Keep required Frontend Design QA workflows self-contained inside the plugin package and prevent development-only path or project-value dependencies.

rules.name: local-phase-boundary
rules.description: Keep Frontend Design QA limited to local CSS, SCSS, visual QA, and handoff writeback while routing server, cache, WST, ACF, WP-CLI, and deployment work out of phase.

skills.name: setup-playwright-mcp
skills.description: Configure Playwright MCP in the local Cursor workspace so Frontend Design QA can drive a real browser for CSS/SCSS QA, verify the browser loop against the active handoff target URL, and record local Playwright MCP readiness in PROJECT-CONTEXT.md and the active handoff. Local workspace only; never used over Remote-SSH.

skills.name: frontend-section-qa
skills.description: Implement and verify a local frontend Section from a filled Section handoff using CSS or SCSS, a Playwright MCP browser QA loop for navigation, snapshots, screenshots, viewports, and selector checks, optional Chrome Local Overrides spikes, and optional project-local Playwright regression acceptance.

skills.name: cpt-frontend-qa
skills.description: Implement and verify local frontend presentation for WST CPT cards, archive or grid views, and optional single templates from a filled CPT foundation handoff using a Playwright MCP browser QA loop and optional project-local Playwright regression acceptance.
